_comment: Neck styles, sleeves and fits. Offered across categories — a buyer picks the body style they want rather than being forced into whatever the category defaults to.

necks.label: Round neck
necks.note: The standard crew neck. Most common, most economical.

necks.label: Polo collar
necks.note: Collar and 2–3 button placket. Reads more formal.

necks.label: V-neck
necks.note: Softer neckline, often preferred for women's fits.

fits.label: Drop shoulder
fits.note: Shoulder seam sits below the natural shoulder.

fits.label: Kids sizing
fits.note: Scaled pattern for school and junior teams.

note: Any neck, sleeve and fit combination can be made to your requirement. If you need something not listed, describe it in your enquiry.
